settings.title: Orders & delivery
settings.text: Share your order number and we will help with status, address changes, or delays.

settings.title: Product fit
settings.text: Tell us what you see on your skin and what you already use. We will point you to the right literacy page or consultation.

settings.title: Returns
settings.text: Start with the money-back page, then write to us so we can confirm eligibility quickly.

settings.heading: We are here for clarity — not scripts.
settings.text: Orders, routines, returns, or a question about what your skin is showing. Write to Project Skin and we will respond with the next useful step.
settings.body_text: Prefer a clinical conversation? Book a dermatologist consultation. Prefer self-serve literacy first? Start with concerns or the journal.
settings.cta_heading: Prefer to speak with a dermatologist?
settings.cta_text: Thirty minutes. Secure video. A written plan you can follow.

settings.heading: Write to Project Skin
settings.text: Share enough context — concern, order number if relevant, and what you need. Our team will reply as soon as possible.
